I initially wanted to post this later, but I didn't expect to finish this so quickly. So here's an early release and a completion to chapter 2. The artist has a really interesting style and the story is quite interesting too, so I hope to read more of this in the future. Hopefully y'all find this as interesting as I did.

As usual, I took a few creative liberties in translating the text to make the text read smoother to native English readers. It's not easy translating Chinese texts, but the result was well worth it in my opinion. I'll release chapter 3 when I'm done with it, which may just be a couple of days out.

I wonder which other artists do similar work as Vchan...
